aggregator.explanation: All six dimension agents favored Lesson 2. The strongest votes were in interactivity and visual accuracy: Lesson 2 has a functioning quiz gate and an accurate circle-region diagram, while Lesson 1 lacks usable interactivity and has empty or garbled visuals. Sync, concept accuracy, and narration also clearly favor Lesson 2 because it provides coherent timed cues, a correct derivation and threshold result, and usable narration, whereas Lesson 1 has little or no available content to evaluate. Polish also favors Lesson 2 despite some presentation flaws, since Lesson 1 appears substantially incomplete. With unanimous votes for Lesson 2 and several high-confidence judgments, the overall winner is clearly Lesson 2.
